user.title: Connect to your router
user.description: Home Assistant logs in to the router's admin interface the same way its web UI does.

data_description.verify_tls: Leave off unless you have replaced the router's self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.description: The router at {host} rejected the password for {username}. Enter the current one.

abort.already_configured: This router is already set up.

user.title: Add a port forward
user.description: Defines a rule that a switch creates on the router when turned on and deletes when turned off. Traffic from any source address is forwarded.

abort.rule_active: This port forward is switched on. Turn it off before editing it.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the router's port forwards.

clear_port_forwards.name: Clear port forwards
clear_port_forwards.description: Deletes every port forward on the router, including ones created outside Home Assistant.

config_entry_id.name: Router
config_entry_id.description: Which router to clear. May be left out when only one is set up.
